signals_info.description: Time headway to the selected lead vehicle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall be greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，与前车的时间车头时距应大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The vehicle shall have more than 2 seconds of headway to the lead vehicle now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆与前车的时间车头时距应在当前或之后某个时刻大于 2 秒。
